digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / rich text codec
propositions: Under rich_text_cutover=cloud, the outbound comment differ computes its two body-equality keys using different decode compositions: the Jira-side key uses adf_to_text (no escaping) while the local-side key uses markdown round-trip that escapes markdown-active characters and rewrites autolinks.
A markdown comment well within length limits never matches its own landed body because the local key preserves markdown escapes while the landed wire does not.

The send path encodes the decorated body through markdown_to_adf, which degrades the whole document to plain text due to the HTML comment decoration, causing the landed wire to be literal markdown in plain paragraphs.
The local key must be derived by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it through the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira-side key.
The truncation notice facet exhibits the same asymmetry: local key carries escaped brackets \[truncated\] while landed body carries unescaped [truncated].
